title: Third-Party CDN Outage With No Local Code Change
description: Static assets (JS, CSS, images) fail to load for all users. The CDN provider (CloudFast) experienced an outage. No local code changes, deployments, or config changes occurred. The evidence available is limited to client-side error reports and CDN status page.
initial_symptoms: Browser console errors: 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT' for CDN URLs
CloudFast status page shows 'Investigating' at 16:05 UTC

evidence_catalog.summary: Client-side error reports show CDN resource timeouts for cdn.cloudfast.net/assets/*
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM client_errors WHERE error LIKE '%cloudfast.net%' AND error LIKE '%timeout%'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate client-side error reports

evidence_catalog.summary: CloudFast CDN status page shows 'Major Outage' starting 16:05 UTC
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will simulate CDN status API response

evidence_catalog.summary: No deployments to any service in last 24 hours
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create empty deployment list

evidence_catalog.summary: No configuration changes in last 24 hours
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create empty config audit

evidence_catalog.summary: DNS resolves but TCP connection to CDN edge servers times out
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will simulate DNS/TCP check results

ground_truth.insufficient_evidence_note: The available evidence strongly suggests a CDN provider outage (CloudFast), but we cannot definitively prove it from our internal telemetry alone. We have: client errors pointing to CDN, CDN status page showing outage, no local changes. However, we cannot access CloudFast's internal systems to confirm root cause. The investigation can only conclude 'external CDN outage' with high confidence but not 100% certainty. A proper diagnosis would state: 'Evidence strongly indicates CloudFast CDN outage (confidence 0.9); no local cause identified; external confirmation needed.'
contributing_factors: No synthetic monitoring of CDN health

misleading_or_confounding_signals: Client errors look like frontend code issues (but are network timeouts)
CDN status page could be stale or inaccurate

acceptable_alternatives.description: CloudFast CDN outage (most likely based on available evidence)
DNS hijacking or routing issue affecting CDN

required_checks.description: Confirm no deployments or config changes
Verify DNS resolves but connection fails
required_checks.expected_outcome: DNS OK, TCP timeout to CDN edges

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Implement multi-CDN fallback; add synthetic CDN monitoring; configure client-side fallback to origin
test_plan: Add CDN health checks to alerting
remediation_guidance.rollback_plan: No rollback needed; wait for provider recovery
